test.create_query: CREATE TABLE tab ( id UInt64, message String, INDEX idx(message) TYPE text(tokenizer = 'splitByNonAlpha'), INDEX idx_lower(lower(message)) TYPE text(tokenizer = 'splitByNonAlpha') ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE tab_no_index (id UInt64, message String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE tab_few_tokens (id UInt64, message String, INDEX idx(message) TYPE text(tokenizer = 'splitByNonAlpha')) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO tab SELECT number, if(number % 10000 = 0, concat('Payment ', toString(number), ' charged twice for user ', toString(number % 997)), concat('Request ', toString(number), ' served in ', toString(number % 1000), ' ms for user ', toString(number % 997), ' status OK')) FROM numbers(3000000)
INSERT INTO tab_no_index SELECT id, message FROM tab

INSERT INTO tab_few_tokens SELECT number, if(number % 10000 = 0, concat('Payment charged twice for user ', toString(number % 997)), concat('Request served in ', toString(number % 1000), ' ms for user ', toString(number % 997), ' status OK')) FROM numbers(3000000)
